headlines.title: 양극화 완화 TF 가동 …“ 재정·세제·금융·규제개선 등에 집중 ”
headlines.summary: 이형일 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 이끄는 양극화 대응 태스크포스(TF)가 본격적인 활동을 시작했습니다. 권대영 재정경제부 1차관과 현수엽 보건복지부 1차관은 오늘(12일) 오전 정부서울청사에서 관계 부처 및 청와대 당국자가 참석한 가운데 ‘양극화 대응 TF’ 총괄반 첫 회의를 열었습니다.

headlines.title: 정부, 양극화 대응 TF 가동 … 5대 분야 격차 완화책 연내 마련
headlines.summary: 노동·산업·지역·세대·사회분야…재정·세제·금융 등 묶어 지원 재정경제부. ⓒ 뉴스1 김기남 기자 (세종=뉴스1) 임용우 기자 = 정부가 노동시장과 산업·기업, 지역, 세대, 사회 등 5대 분야의 격차를 줄이기 위한 핵심과제를 발굴하기 위한 TF를 본격 가동한다.

headlines.title: " 모두가 성장하고 있나, 정부가 답할 때 " … 정부, '양극화 대응 TF' 본격 ...
headlines.summary: 양극화 대응 발표 하루만에 TF 총괄반 1차 회의 [서울=뉴시스] 권대영 재정경제부 차관이 11일 서울 종로구 정부서울청사에서 열린 제13차 일자리 전담반(TF)에 참석해 발언하고 있다. (사진=재경부 제공) 2026.11.11. photo@newsis.

headlines.title: ‘ 양극화 대응 ’ 범부처 TF 가동 … 조선업 원·하청 상생협약 추진
headlines.summary: 노동·산업·지역·세대·사회 5대 분야 대응 부처 합의 과제 ‘2027년 경제성장전략’ 반영 정부가 노동시장과 산업·기업, 지역, 세대, 사회 등 5대 분야의 양극화 해소를 위해 재정·세제·금융·규제개선을 아우르는 정책 패키지를 추진한다.

headlines.title: 충청권 메가프로젝트 착공기념 시삽하는 이 대통령
headlines.summary: (아산=연합뉴스) 신준희 기자 = 이재명 대통령이 12일 충남 아산 삼성전자 온양캠퍼스 건설현장에서 열린 충청권 메가프로젝트 착공식에서 이재용 삼성전자 회장 등과 함께 기념 시삽을 하고 있다.

headlines.title: 美 의회, ' 반도체 수출 통제 3법' 탄력...韓 업체에도 불똥 튀나
headlines.summary: [파이낸셜뉴스] 젠슨 황(왼쪽) 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 대만 타이베이에서 지난해 5월 22일(현지시간) 주최한 만찬에 앨리스 황이 참석해 미소 짓고 있다. AP 뉴시스 미국 의회의 대중국 반도체 수출 규제 강화 3법에 다시 탄력이 붙고 있다고 월스트리트저널(WSJ)이 11일(현지시간) 보도했다.

headlines.title: 반도체 호황 누른 유가 … KDI " 소비에 부정적 영향 먼저 반영 "
headlines.summary: 올해 유가 탓 소비 증가율 0.4%p↓…내년 반도체로 소비 증가율 0.6%p↑ "최고가격제, 3∼10월 소비자물가 상승률 평균 약 0.6%p 낮춰" "추가 수요 진작정책 필요성 크지 않아…비반도체 임금 여건 개선해야" 석유 최고가격제 12차 최고가격 발표 앞둔 주유소 (서울=연합뉴스) 박동주 기자 = 12일 서울 서초구 만남의광장 주유소에 유가가 표시돼있다

headlines.title: 반도체 호황 온기는 '아직' … 유가 충격에 민간소비 회복 '발목'
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 KDI, '최근 반도체 호황과 유가 상승이 민간소비에 미치는 영향' 보고서 KDI "반도체 효과는 4분기 뒤 나타나…올해 유가 충격에 소비 증가율 0.4%p 하락" 내년 반도체 효과 0.6%p 상승 전망…임금 정체·금리 부담은 변수 한국개발연구원(KDI) 경제전망실 김지연(가운데) 전망총괄 및 마창석(왼쪽)·이승희 연구위원.

headlines.title: 9월만 법인세 36조 걷혀 … 나라살림 적자 1년새 70조 축소
headlines.summary: 1~9월 32조 적자, 1년새 70.5조↓ 기업 호실적에 누적 법인세 52조↑ 중앙정부 채무 1369조, 101조 증가 기업 실적 개선에 따른 법인세 급증으로 올해 1~9월 나라살림 적자가 1년 새 70조원 넘게 줄었다. 9월 한 달에만 법인세가 36조원 넘게 걷히면서 월간 재정수지가 적자에서 흑자로 돌아섰다.

headlines.title: 국제금융기구 채용설명회 … 13개 기관 한국 찾아 면접 · 컨설팅
headlines.summary: 12일부터 이틀간 성균관대학교서 열려 제18회 국제금융기구 채용설명회 [자료=재정경제부 제공] (세종=연합뉴스) 안채원 기자 = 13개 국제금융기구가 한국에서 채용 설명회를 열고 직접 면접과 컨설팅을 한다. 재정경제부는 12일부터 13일까지 서울 성균관대학교에서 '제18회 국제금융기구 채용설명회'를 한다고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 내년 전국 오피스텔 기준시가 4년째 하락 … 서울은 2%대 상승
headlines.summary: 상업용 건물도 0.8% 하락 전망…국세청, 기준시가안 공개 서울 시내 부동산에 붙어 있는 오피스텔 매물 [연합뉴스 자료사진] (세종=연합뉴스) 송정은 기자 = 내년 전국 오피스텔 기준시가가 약 0.5% 하락할 것으로 보인다. 4년 연속 하락세다. 서울은 2%대 상승해 4년 만에 가장 높은 상승률을 기록할 것으로 전망된다.

headlines.title: 서울 집합건물 증여받은 20대 1년새 2.2배↑
headlines.summary: 집값상승·稅부담에 조기증여 확산 1~10월 수증인 전년비 62% 증가 20대 828명→1781명 증가율 1위 청년 세대 간 자산 격차 심화 우려 높아진 집값과 세금 부담에 부동산 증여가 활발해지면서 서울의 집합건물을 물려받은 사람의 수가 1년 새 60% 넘게 급증한 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.summary: 나라살림연구소, 2027년 예산안 분석 사업비 45.4조 중 계속사업에 23.6조 “기존사업 재편에 절반, 기금 효과 의문” 정부가 내년 신설하는 미래대응기금의 첫해 사업비 45조4000억원 가운데 절반 이상을 기존 사업에 배정하면서 기금의 신규 정책 효과를 둘러싼 의문이 제기되고 있다.

key_headlines.title: US Congress strengthens semiconductor export controls to China, affecting Korean companies
key_headlines.summary: The US Congress is reinforcing three semiconductor export restriction bills targeting China, which could have spillover effects on Korean semiconductor manufacturers. The Wall Street Journal reported that momentum is building for these enhanced export control measures.

key_headlines.title: KDI reports high oil prices suppress consumer spending while semiconductor boom delayed
key_headlines.summary: The Korea Development Institute found that rising oil prices reduced consumer spending growth by 0.4 percentage points this year, while semiconductor sector benefits are expected to contribute 0.6 percentage points to consumption growth next year. However, the semiconductor boom effects are lagging due to delayed wage growth transmission.

key_headlines.title: Government launches inter-agency task force to address income inequality across five sectors
key_headlines.summary: The government launched a comprehensive task force led by Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hyung-seok to address polarization in labor, industry, regions, generations, and society through coordinated fiscal, tax, financial, and regulatory policies. The 2027 economic growth strategy will incorporate these multi-sector initiatives.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI falls 23% in one month, worst performance among major global indices
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's KOSPI index has declined 23.4% since end-September, posting the largest drop among 15 major global stock indices. Foreign investors have withdrawn funds from Korean securities markets for nine consecutive months amid concerns about US data center regulations and slowing AI investment.

key_headlines.title: Meta's AI infrastructure chief resigns amid astronomical AI investment spending
key_headlines.summary: Santoshi Janardan, Meta's infrastructure chief who led AI data center expansion, announced his resignation to take effect by Q1 2027. The departure comes as Meta's AI infrastructure spending now exceeds advertising revenue, raising market concerns about sustainability of massive AI investments.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economy faces a mixed outlook as semiconductor export prices surge 145% year-over-year while consumer spending remains pressured by elevated oil prices. The Korea Development Institute reports that this year's oil price shock reduced consumption growth by 0.4 percentage points, offsetting minimal immediate benefits from semiconductor sector gains. Looking ahead, semiconductor-related consumption effects are expected to provide 0.6 percentage points of growth next year as corporate profits eventually translate into household income. The government has launched a comprehensive inter-agency task force addressing polarization across labor, industry, regional, generational, and social dimensions, with plans to integrate these initiatives into the 2027 economic growth strategy.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Korean government is actively pursuing policies to mitigate income inequality through coordinated fiscal, tax, financial, and regulatory measures across five key sectors. Harvard economist Kenneth Rogoff warned that South Korea must preserve fiscal capacity despite favorable short-term GDP growth from semiconductor booms, as aging populations will increase mandatory spending on pensions and healthcare, potentially raising national debt to 173% of GDP. The government is considering additional consumer stimulus measures, though KDI analysis suggests current non-semiconductor wage conditions need improvement before aggressive spending programs are warranted. US Federal Reserve officials are signaling potential 50 basis point rate hikes in December, which would increase financing burdens for Korean entities and potentially trigger currency and interest rate pressures.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korea's KOSPI index has plummeted 23.4% since late September, registering the worst performance among 15 major global stock indices as foreign investors continue net outflows for nine consecutive months. Trading volume on the KOSPI has evaporated 60% over six months as investor sentiment weakens amid concerns about US data center regulation tightening and slowing artificial intelligence investment momentum. The broader market remains caught between gains in AI infrastructure companies like CoreWeave and uncertainty surrounding semiconductor giant Nvidia's guidance on data center demand. Uncertainty surrounding Federal Reserve policy and elevated US Treasury yields have particularly pressured growth stocks, with trading activity concentrated among defensive positions.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's semiconductor sector achieved record export price increases of 145.3% year-over-year through September, though immediate consumer spending effects remain minimal as corporate profits require time to translate into wages and dividends. President Lee Yoon-suk directed support for traditional manufacturing sectors including automobiles and shipbuilding to strengthen global competitiveness in electric vehicles and autonomous driving technologies. Korean startups dominated innovation awards at CES 2027, with six of ten top innovation prizes going to Korean companies, while major conglomerates like LG secured recognition for battery diagnostics, vehicle lighting, and robotics display technologies. Advanced semiconductor technology is being leveraged to develop next-generation renewable energy solutions, addressing growing power demands from artificial intelligence infrastructure expansion.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's real estate market is experiencing price adjustments as the Gangnam premium weakens, with price declines spreading to Han River belt areas including Seongdong and Gangdong districts after 92 consecutive weeks of gains. The Seoul metropolitan housing market is projected to appreciate 3.0% in 2027, a moderation from recent years due to elevated loan rates and macroeconomic uncertainty, while nationwide jeonse (long-term lease) prices are expected to rise 4.5%. The former CBS broadcast building in Mokdong will be redeveloped into senior housing and business facilities, reflecting changing demographic needs and commercial real estate trends. Despite recent price pressures in some segments, analysts note that rent affordability concerns in outer Seoul districts limit widespread price declines as survival purchases continue in affordable areas.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve is debating the timing and magnitude of interest rate policy, with Fed official Christopher Waller advocating for potential 50 basis point hikes in December if core CPI remains near 3% or higher, citing credit concerns. President Trump has demanded Mexico prevent unauthorized immigration and threatened to double tariffs immediately if enforcement proves insufficient, signaling aggressive trade policy continuation. Oil price shocks are spreading inflationary pressures globally, complicating monetary policy decisions as energy costs transmit through food prices and broader consumption. Market-implied probabilities show 100% probability of Fed rate action in December with 13.2% likelihood of the larger 50 basis point move, with critical economic data releases scheduled before the decision.
sections.AI & Economy: Meta's resignation of infrastructure chief Santoshi Janardan amid unprecedented AI spending levels signals market concerns about the sustainability of massive artificial intelligence infrastructure investments that now exceed advertising revenues. The departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's wife from the scene raises questions about potential disruptions to semiconductor export policy coordination and China-US technology competition dynamics under Trump administration influence. The government launched Team Korea Energy initiative to expand international infrastructure exports and green energy technology, leveraging Korean expertise in power systems and AI-driven energy solutions to capture emerging global market opportunities. Data center regulation tightening in the United States is creating demand for noise reduction technologies and power infrastructure solutions, with Korean companies positioned to capture opportunities in transformer-related nano-materials and electrical infrastructure exports.
sections.Others: Japanese medical institutions are aggressively recruiting Korean patients for obesity treatment procedures at costs up to five times cheaper than domestic options, benefiting from approved import of three-month supplies of foreign-prescribed medications. Pearl Abyss reported Q3 earnings with 1.015 trillion won revenue (18% YoY growth) but 8.8% operating profit decline, attributed to environmental factors including exchange rate headwinds offsetting strong game performance. Asia's data center investment remains insufficient despite accelerating demand, with per-capita capacity lagging Europe and North America while renewable energy integration offers additional investment opportunities in emerging economies. Discussions are underway between US Vice President JD Vance and Iranian officials regarding potential diplomatic engagement to resolve Middle East conflicts, with proposals for mutual concessions on maritime blockades and Strait of Hormuz transit permissions.
